import Foundation
actor Store {
  var saved: [Int] = []
  func save(_ item: Int) { saved.append(item) }
  func count() -> Int { saved.count }
}
@main struct Main {
  static func main() async {
    let store = Store()
    var tasks: [Task<Void, Never>] = []
    for item in [1, 2, 3] {
      let task = Task<Void, Never> { [item] in
        print(item)
      }
      tasks.append(task)
      await store.save(item)
    }
    let count = await store.count()
    precondition(count == 3)
    print("saved=3")
  }
}
